title: eludite.workspace.recent input
description: The recent workspaces and files (brief 0072): what the Welcome page's Open recent list and File > Recent Workspaces show, kept per user in recent.json in the config directory and written whenever a workspace or file opens. Read only; open one with eludite.workspace.open_folder (a workspace) or eludite.file.open (a file).

query.description: Only entries whose name or path contains this, ignoring case.
